description: Review pasted URLs or paths (no fetching). Give `urls`, one per line, up to 500. Reports trailing slash mix, capital letters (paths are case-sensitive on many servers), mixed word separators (hyphen, underscore, camelCase), run-together words, file extensions, opaque ID segments, query parameters, session IDs, encoded characters, double slashes, depth (more than 4 segments), segments over 40 characters, years in paths, www/non-www and http/https mixing, URLs that differ only by case, slash or separator, singular/plural twins of one section, and an overall percentage of readable segments. Pattern checks on the strings only; it cannot see redirects.

urls.description: URLs or paths, one per line (up to 500)
